seed: Objects of type `target` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: no_change x3, gone x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the presence, type or relative position of a neighbouring object. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes: Player 5x5 steps one 5px cell per action (1:y-5,2:y+5,3:x-5,4:x+5) along a fixed corridor set; off-corridor moves are no-ops; cell (9,5) is a portal to (34,5). Every action burns 2 budget: step_bar w-2, x+2, right edge 55; landing on a refuel ring consumes it and refills the bar to 42. Layer-1 player fully occludes covered layer-0 objects: they drop out and are restored verbatim when uncovered (diamond). Open hypotheses: portal destination seen once; maze known only where walked; actions 5/6/7 unobserved (assumed budget-only).
